name: Can you patch a drywall hole directly over wallpaper?
description: No, compound moisture causes wallpaper glue to lift. You must peel away the loose wallpaper and seal the underlying paper before patching and taping.

mainEntity.name: Can you patch a drywall hole directly over wallpaper?

acceptedAnswer.text: Spreading joint compound over wallpaper is not recommended because moisture in the compound weakens the wallpaper adhesive, causing blistering and peeling over time. The correct approach depends on the room: either strip the wallpaper from the damaged section and prime the exposed facing paper with a sealing primer, or remove the wallpaper completely across that wall face. Applying a proper drywall patch requires direct bonding to clean gypsum board or existing sound drywall paper to prevent bubbling under the repair.
